value.rationale: A complete six-value low-list capacity profile is a natural exact finite-code invariant for the seven-bit two-deletion hypergraph introduced in recent work; it is not a single numerical substitution. The sharp nonintegral fractional packing optimum supplies a second structural calibration with a nontrivial integrality gap and completely checkable finite duality, useful when evaluating incidence-relaxation bounds at short blocklengths.
